question: How closely does the fixed five-brightest-catalogue-entry pattern in each IAU constellation match the existing LP2 five-dot artwork under a similarity transform?
claim_limit: Geometric measurement of this finite catalogue/projection selection, not constellation identification, a cipher solution or discovery. Not every five-star subset or traditional line map.

primary_artwork.points: Five existing threshold140 component centroids, in their frozen left-to-right order. No new point measurement, threshold selection or crop changes.
primary_artwork.dependence: Repeated shared artwork, not three independent observations. Primary selected before fitting; no best-of-three search or combined p-value.

catalogue: Fixed constellation-candidates.json: 88 official IAU constellations; exactly five HR entries each, ranked by Vmag then integer HR after Roman1987 membership on fixed FK5 J2000 coordinates. No proper-motion, epoch, star-subset or membership tuning.
duplicates: Retain distinct HR components, including selected close pairs in Cen/Cru/Gem. Explicitly call these five catalogue entries, not five unresolved naked-eye points. No merging, flux combination or hand replacement.
projection: Already-fixed gnomonic_xy in constellation-candidates.json, tangent centre at unweighted mean unit direction of those five stars. No alternate projection or fitted centre. All88 validated finite/front-hemisphere/nonzero radius.

fit.correspondence: Enumerate all120 bijections between the fixed five stars and five target dots.
fit.transforms: Translation, arbitrary planar rotation, positive uniform scale; both orientation-preserving and reflected similarities. Exactly2 determinant branches perpermutation; no anisotropic scale,shear,star omission or line-map choices.
fit.objective: For centred X(stars),Y(permuted dots), solve constrained orthogonal Procrustes analytically. Optimize positive uniform scale. Primary score sqrt(SSE/sum||Y-Ymean||²), equivalently RMS residual divided by target RMSradius; lower is closer. Save RMS pixels, maximum residual, scale,angle,reflection,permutation and allfive residual vectors.
fit.candidate_count: 88 ×120 ×2 =21120 labelled registrations for the primary shape. Nuisance choices and parameter settings are not separate solving ideas.
fit.ties: Scores equal within1e-12 reported as tie set; stable display order by IAU shortname,lexicographic permutation,orientation-preserving before reflected. Preserve full scores, not only chosen winner.
fit.implementation_check: Direct NumPy SVD reference versus exact2D closed-form/optimized batched implementation on fixed synthetic cases; residual agreement<=1e-12 before target. Near-collinear and reflected cases included.
fit.implementation: Exact closed-form 2D similarity, enumerating all labelled permutations and orientation branches; stable residual vectors rather than cancellation-prone 1−correlation². Independent SVD code uses original unnormalized coordinates. Zero-correlation branch gets score1 as positive-scale infimum, flaggedzero-scale in witnesses, never presented as a positive-scale exact match.
